text: Example For a steel quenching process for ball bearings to work, the ball bearing must quickly drop in temperature from >1000°C to 100°C. The initial ball temperature is 1200°C and it is dipped in cold water at 25°C. The ball radius is 1 mm. The heat transfer coefficient is h = 10,000 W/m2K. Determine how long the quenching time should be. Note: Neglect radiation relative to convection. Kyeel = 50 W/mK @ Cp,steel = 502 J/kgK Psteel = 8000 kg/m3
